name: 48867 · Owosso, MI
findings: ZIP 48867 (Owosso) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48867 (Owosso) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48867 (Owosso) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.
